notes.title: Princess Ruby is Releasing today!
notes.notes:
[h1]Princess Ruby is releasing today![/h1]
Check out the release trailer showing me playing the game with it’s namesake, my daughter Ruby. 

[previewyoutube=uwVZmsgkmB0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hopefully many more kids can enjoy the game the way we have and I hope it can let some families enjoy games together.
